content.short: Nolus is a semi-permissioned blockchain bridging lenders and borrowers in a DeFi money market.
content.description: Nolus addresses notable inefficiencies in the DeFi lending and borrowing space by applying its DeFi Lease concept. This approach enables borrowers to secure financing up to 150% of their initial investments, providing a built-in leverage option that broadens access to capital. In addition, it unlocks access to leveraged assets through whitelisted strategies, further expanding liquidity and flexibility for users.
